[[Seradane]] is an area in northeastern part of [[The Hinterlands]] which houses one of the four entrances to the [[Emerald Dream]]. Many high-level [[elite]] green [[dragon]]s make their home here. One of the [[Dragons of Nightmare]] ([[Emeriss]], [[Lethon]], [[Taerar]], [[Ysondre]]) may also appear here.

The skull of an unknown dragon is also to be found lying on top of a hill slightly to the north of the portal.
